.teacher { margin: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0px; min-width: 0px; height: 100%; }.teacher-window { position: relative; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0px; border-radius: var(--radius-window); overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; }.teacher-window--bare { border-radius: 50%; }.teacher-ground, .teacher-ground > * { position: absolute; inset: 0px; display: block; }.teacher-ground-paper { background: var(--paper); }.teacher-ground-stage { background: var(--stage); opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--m-lights) var(--ease-standard); }.teacher-ground-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--m-lights) var(--ease-standard); }.teacher-ground-pool { background: var(--stage-pool); opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--m-lights) var(--ease-standard) 150ms; }.teacher[data-lights="down"] .teacher-ground-stage, .teacher[data-lights="down"] .teacher-ground-art, .teacher[data-lights="down"] .teacher-ground-pool { opacity: 1; }.teacher-face-host { inset: 0px; position: absolute !important; min-height: 0px !important; }.teacher-window--bare .teacher-face-host { background: var(--stage); }.teacher-label { flex: 0 0 auto; padding-top: var(--space-2); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: var(--t-meta); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); text-align: center; line-height: 1.3; }.teacher-aitag { position: absolute; left: 0px; bottom: 0px; z-index: 2; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; padding: 3px 5px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); }.teacher-aipicto { position: absolute; right: var(--space-2); top: var(--space-2); width: 40px; height: 40px; z-index: 2; background: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }.teacher-aipicto > * { width: 100%; height: 100%; }.art-fallback { display: block; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }.art-fallback-shape { position: absolute; inset: 12%; border-radius: 50% 46% 52% 48%; opacity: 0.55; }

texts.value: How many quarters make one half?
Your turn. How many quarters make one half?
Bilkul sahi, aur tumne bade hisse ko pehchaana. Board dekho: 1/2 barabar 2/4. Toh ek half mein kitne quarters hote hain?

node.textContent: Count the shaded quarters on the board.
Chalo ek baar phir dekhte hain.

texts.value: Chalo ek baar phir dekhte hain. Board par shaded parts gino.
